headline: Chilean Regulator Threatens State Oil Firm ENAP With $19 Million Emissions Fine
summary: Environmental regulators in Chile accused state oil company ENAP of providing false and incomplete emissions data at its Aconcagua refinery. The company faces potential fines of up to $19 million.
why: Empresa Nacional del Petróleo (ENAP) is Chile's state-owned energy company responsible for refining and domestic fuel distribution.

impacts.name: ENAP
impacts.why: Regulatory fines and compliance mandates increase operating expenses for the state refiner.
